pullRequests.body:
## Summary

```text
Merged PR
├── Preview with ghcr.io/lhajoosten/release-log:latest and a read-only App token
└── Recompute and verify in a separate SHA-pinned writer with its own App token
```

The writer reads the GitHub event, source history and shared checked-in configuration independently. It receives no preview outputs or artifacts. Writes run by default when the App is configured. Set the Actions configuration variable `RELEASE_LOG_WRITE_ENABLED` to `false` to keep previews and disable writes.

The writer uses Release Log v0.5.2 and retains v0.5.1 for replay of existing generated proposals. The App configuration enables the job by default. `RELEASE_LOG_WRITE_ENABLED=false` replaces the previous enable flag.

## Evidence

- `actionlint` passed.
- Checked both jobs share the same captured release configuration, the Docker step has a read-only token and `--dry-run`, and the writer gets only trusted inputs.
- The website’s `pnpm check` passed.
- Live post-merge writes with the installed App were outside local verification.

## Merge Danger

**Door** Two-way. Set `RELEASE_LOG_WRITE_ENABLED=false` to pause the writer, or revert the workflow change.

**Blast radius** Release proposal maintenance, exact-landing tags, and GitHub Releases where configured.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Separate read-only Release Log previews from release writes.
impact: Release previews follow the latest stable CLI while a pinned writer applies verified release changes.
required_action: null
```

Move the release workflow to rolling-release.yml and use the canonical provider slug for release writing, metadata checkout, and the project’s GitHub links and version lookup. Keep the existing pins, GHCR path, and site routes.

## Evidence

Workflow lint and whitespace checks passed. Required GitHub checks are tracked on this pull request.

## Merge sequence

Merge after GitHub resolves `lhajoosten/rolling-release` for the existing provider repository. The reusable workflow path is tied to the repository slug.

## Summary

```diff
- Release Log
+ Rolling Release
- Lint Action → github.com/lhajoosten/lint-action
+ Lint Gate → github.com/lhajoosten/lint-gate
```

Update the homepage, projects index, case-study titles and page metadata. The existing case-study URLs continue to serve both pages, and the Lint Gate source citation keeps its reviewed commit.

## Verification

- GitHub resolves the new repository URLs and the pinned Lint Gate README.
- `pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false check` passed.
- `pnpm build` passed. The generated case-study HTML contains the new titles, current repository links and existing canonical URLs.
- `pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false test:e2e --workers=2` passed all 62 desktop and mobile tests, including dark mode, reduced motion and JavaScript-disabled navigation.
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Merge Danger

**Door** — two-way

**Blast radius** — portfolio copy, metadata and repository links

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Update the portfolio to use Rolling Release and Lint Gate.
impact: Project pages show the current names and link to the renamed repositories. Existing bookmarks still work.
required_action: null
```
